purpose: Bounded fictional count simulation and estimator comparison; no missing market evidence replacement
timeline: 2010-Q1 through 2021-Q4; simulated publication 20 days after quarter end; actual target lead two quarters
scenario_groups: Entire families are disjoint: stable/rising/falling train; seasonal/sparse validation; abrupt/missing/coverage_change test; damped_cycle additional robustness only. Two correlated role/skill variants per group stay together.
group_assignment: fixed before any random draws; correlated role/skill pair always same group and split
parameters: Exact fixed equations, missing-quarter positions and coverage epochs are versioned in the generator; group scale uniform[0.85,1.15], role noise integer[-2,2], skill approx 55% with noise[-1,1] capped at role count
generator_fitting: none; no calibration or parameter selection using data or test metrics
chronological_split: train labels published before 2018; validation issues 2018-2019 and labels published before 2020; test and robustness issues 2020 onwards; unknown targets/history excluded without imputation
forbidden_uses: independent accuracy or augmentation benefit claims
limitations: Related variants remain related even with different seeds
No privacy-sensitive inputs or restricted source records used
